say:1:1710306001:1.text: Captain, what brings you here? Do you have any special instructions for us?
say:1:1710306001:1.source_cn: 队长，您怎么亲自来上城区了！请您下达指示！

say:3:1710306002:1.text: Has the Commander been here today?
say:3:1710306002:1.source_cn: 克雷因，司令今天有没有来过这里？

say:4:1710306003:1.text: The Commander did come by earlier! He was in a hurry and said he'd just received an urgent report...
say:4:1710306003:1.source_cn: 司令早些时候确实来过！他来得很急，说他刚收到一份紧急报告——

say:5:1710306004:1.text: It was about the disappearance of Alaine, the curator of the Evergreen Exhibition!
say:5:1710306004:1.source_cn: 冬青展览馆的馆长阿莱茵女士失踪了！

say:6:1710306005:1.text: He came here to look into <style="highlight">Alaine's</style> case himself.
say:6:1710306005:1.source_cn: 他来这里，就是为了亲自核查<style=highlig...

say:7:1710306006:1.text: And then? What did he do?

say:8:1710306007:1.text: The Commander asked about the exhibition hall's recent security and patrol situation. I... I reported everything truthfully...
say:8:1710306007:1.source_cn: 司令追问了展览馆近期的安保和巡逻情况。我……我就如实汇...

choice_prompt:9:1710306007.text: The Commander asked about the exhibition hall's recent security and patrol situation. I... I reported everything truthfully...
choice_prompt:9:1710306007.source_cn: 司令追问了展览馆近期的安保和巡逻情况。我……我就如实汇报了……

say:10:1710306008:0.text: The curator recently upgraded the exhibition hall's security, bringing in more magical guards and defensive mechanisms.
say:10:1710306008:0.source_cn: 阿莱茵馆长在展览馆内升级了安保措施——引入了更多魔法守...

say:11:1710306009:0.text: She said she didn't need us Royal Guard anymore...
say:11:1710306009:0.source_cn: 她说有那些就够了，不需要我们……

say:12:1710306010:0.text: ... The curator complained that our patrols were ruining the view.
say:12:1710306010:0.source_cn: ……阿莱茵馆长投诉我们，说我们在附近的巡逻会破坏展馆的...

say:13:1710306011:1.text: So... we cut back patrols in the area.
say:13:1710306011:1.source_cn: 所以……我们就减少了那条路线的巡逻频次。

say:14:1710306012:1.text: That's preposterous! You said the Commander came here to investigate Alaine's disappearance.
say:14:1710306012:1.source_cn: 胡闹！司令接到了阿莱茵馆长的失踪报告，所以赶来调查。

say:15:1710306013:1.text: He must have realized the exhibition hall was outside the patrol area, so he went inside to investigate.
say:15:1710306013:1.source_cn: 他发现失踪地点是一个巡逻盲区，所以他应当是进入了展览馆...

say:16:1710306014:1.text: You're right! After I briefed the Commander, he ordered me to secure the perimeter while he entered the exhibition hall by himself.
say:16:1710306014:1.source_cn: 队长，您说的没错！司令听完我的汇报就让我守好外围，他自...

say:17:1710306015:1.text: Come to think of it, he's been in there for quite a while... Do you need him urgently?
say:17:1710306015:1.source_cn: 司令确实进去好一阵子了……队长，你们找他有急事吗？

choice_prompt:18:1710306015.text: Come to think of it, he's been in there for quite a while... Do you need him urgently?
choice_prompt:18:1710306015.source_cn: 司令确实进去好一阵子了……队长，你们找他有急事吗？

say:19:1710306016:1.text: What?! The Commander... he's missing too?!
say:19:1710306016:1.source_cn: 啊？！司、司令也……也失踪了吗？！

say:20:1710306017:1.text: I-I thought he was still checking things inside...
say:20:1710306017:1.source_cn: 我、我以为他只是在里面调查……

say:21:1710306018:1.text: ... Kleinford, just hold your position here and don't let anyone get near.
say:21:1710306018:1.source_cn: ……好了，克雷因，你继续守好这里，不许任何人靠近！

say:23:1710306020:1.text: Let's take a look inside the exhibition hall.
say:23:1710306020:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下，我们进去展览馆看看。
say:23:1710306020:1.male: Let's take a look inside the exhibition hall.
say:23:1710306020:1.female: Let's take a look inside the exhibition hall.

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 亨德里克可能也失踪了

choice:18:1:2.text: We're here to look for him.
